Title: ROOM ACOUSTIC DESIGN
Description: When placed in an unprepared space, even the best sonic equipment will not produce high-quality audio. We work with aural variables such as reverberation time, sound reflection and loudness levels to optimize room acoustics and smooth out the environment’s flaws.
